name: 12_multi_series_router
description: One issuer, three live series: S1 (tier 2), S2 (tier 1 split router + tier 2 proofs: routed amounts are credited against each quarter's attested payment — shortfall paid, excess carried, year reset) and S3 (pure tier 1: reports bind to the router's period checkpoints through Poseidon(2)(ytd_at_end, 0) with no attestation). Issuance stop/resume gates new series only.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces, prior/income commitments, liquidity flags) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.

steps.note: tier-1 flag without router terms
r_wad × units_offered = 10 WAD > WAD
tier flags 1|2: on-chain split router (plaintext θ and r, the issuer's choice) plus attested quarterly proofs
pure tier 1: reports are bound to the router checkpoints and need no attestation
three series settled: 400 units each at 105; r × units = 4% on each
existing series are unaffected by the issuance stop
below θ: 100% to the issuer
S3: 80,000 passes, 10,000 above θ → 400 routed (4%)
50,000 below θ passes; 4% of 10,000 = 400 to the vault (fee 20); routerCredit 400
routerCredit 400; vault 380; ytd 90,000
a series with tier 2 enabled must report with the attested tier
payment 400 fully covered by router credit → due 0
no receipt arrived in Q2 yet, so Q1's checkpoint is missing
keeper closes Q1: ytd_at_end = 90,000
tier-1 report: income_commitment = Poseidon(2)(90,000e6, 0); payment 400 covered by router credit
Q1 reconciled: routerCredit 0, lastPaidPeriod 8104
all above θ: 1,600 routed
the Q2 receipt closes S3's Q1 checkpoint implicitly (already closed) and routes 2,000
owed YTD 2,400, payment 2,000; credit 1,600 → shortfall 400 due
ytd_at_end 140,000 → payment 2,000, fully routed already → due 0
S3 routerCredit 0 after reconciling 2,400 of routed income
payment 1,600 < credit 2,000 → due 0, credit 400 carried
no receipts in Q3: checkpoint holds the year total so far (140,000)
payment 0
routerCredit 400 carried forward
2026 gross on S2 = 4% × 120,000 = 4,800 (router 4,000 + issuer 800); holders got 95%
2027: below θ again → 100% pass-through; the receipt closes 2026 Q4 for S2's router
closes S3's Q4 2026 checkpoint (140,000) and resets the year
Q4 2026 bound to the closed checkpoint; prior = Poseidon(2)(140,000e6, 0)
S3 2026 complete: 2,400 routed and reconciled, nothing paid by the issuer directly
S1 untouched by the routers
